data_architecture.authority: 有效岗位 use_platform 控制登录资格；岗位规则独立控制菜单/API，无前端补授权
data_architecture.events: 仅沿用登录审计与兼容账号投影；不产生经营事实、金额或库存事件
data_architecture.concurrency: 沿用现有投影、缓存与令牌机制，不更改业务写事务
data_architecture.permissions: 后端登录入口判断；既有前端业务路由鉴权不放宽；已登记 API 空授权不放行
data_architecture.snapshots: 覆盖当前用户菜单与权限，避免继承上一用户状态
data_architecture.performance: 移除登录入口的菜单规则查询；空规则菜单/搜索提前返回
data_architecture.reconciliation: 本地事务测试覆盖开关、岗位状态、绑定状态/结束/删除、空规则及有菜单
data_architecture.transfer_authority: Platform target identity directory and draft validation do not require receiver store/organization data permission; source and subsequent command authority unchanged; store-terminal paths unchanged
data_architecture.transfer_events: Synthetic draft creation/readback/idempotent replay under outer rollback only; no real inventory or production writes; no schema migration
data_architecture.inventory_authority: Corresponding function still gates creation and source scope remains enforced; platform receiving identity is not an operator data grant, per explicit product decision; tenant and active entity checks remain; no real grants mutated
